weak_joints: Existence and identity: spec treats SAGE as a built L4/L5 productizable service, but repo SAGE is the Discernment kinematic pre-screen, first in the pipeline, and svc-sage-should-it-exist-decision is HELD on an efficacy gate that has no data.

Stack and substrate: Next 15+Tailwind+Supabase Auth/RLS+Railway+OpenAI embeddings+new receipt tables all contradict the repo (Next 16, inline styles, Auth.js, Vercel service, Prisma Receipt/decision_receipt); VECTOR(3072) cannot be indexed.

Calibration and immutability promises: 0.85 confidence, NCI grades, n>=5 and sealed receipts rest on an NCI that means something else in the repo, no calibration data (accountant curve HOLDING, outcomes ~2/247), and an immutability-vs-GDPR-erasure conflict.
